title: Low-Rank Plus Sparse Matrix Transfer Learning under Growing Representations and Ambient Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2601.21873v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning systems often expand their ambient features or latent representations over time, embedding earlier representations into larger spaces with limited new latent structure. We study transfer learning for structured matrix estimation under simultaneous growth of the ambient dimension and the intrinsic representation, where a well-estimated source task is embedded as a subspace of a higher-dimensional target task.   We propose a general transfer framework in which the target parameter decomposes into an embedded source component, low-dimensional low-rank innovations, and sparse edits, and develop an anchored alternating projection estimator that preserves transferred subspaces while estimating only low-dimensional innovations and sparse modifications. translated_title: 增长表示与环境维度下的低秩加稀疏矩阵迁移学习
translated_abstract: 学习系统往往会随时间扩展其环境特征或潜在表示，将早期表示嵌入到更大的空间中，而仅引入有限的新潜在结构。我们研究了在环境维度与内在表示同时增长情况下的结构化矩阵估计迁移学习问题，其中估计良好的源任务被嵌入为更高维目标任务的一个子空间。我们提出了一个通用的迁移框架，其中目标参数分解为嵌入的源分量、低维低秩创新分量以及稀疏编辑分量，并开发了一种锚定交替投影估计器，该估计器在保留已迁移子空间的同时，仅估计低维创新和稀疏修改。我们建立了确定性的误差界，将目标噪声、表示增长和源估计误差的贡献分离开来，当秩与稀疏度增量受限时可获得严格更优的误差率。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个在环境维度与潜在表示同时增长情形下的低秩加稀疏矩阵迁移学习框架，通过锚定交替投影估计器在保留已迁移子空间的同时仅估计低维创新与稀疏修改，实现了严格更优的误差率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a low-rank-plus-sparse matrix transfer learning framework under simultaneously growing ambient dimensions and latent representations, where an anchored alternating projection estimator preserves transferred subspaces while estimating only low-dimensional innovations and sparse edits, achieving strictly improved error rates.
